messages.content: What is the largest desert in the world?

Hello! I'd be happy to help you with your question. The largest desert in the world is the Sahara Desert, which is located in North Africa and covers an area of approximately 9,400,000 square kilometers (3,600,000 square miles). It spans across several countries, including Algeria, Chad, Egypt, Libya, Mali, Mauritania, Morocco, Niger, and Tunisia. The Sahara Desert is known for its extreme heat and arid conditions, with some areas receiving less than 20 millimeters (0.8 inches) of rainfall per year. I hope this information is helpful!
